pages.text:
Server settings (in the fusion section of the Arcforge config) change how hard fusion is:
- reactor.disruptionBlockDamage: whether disruptions and runaways melt blocks out of the vessel.
- reactor.quenchDamage: whether a quench without a Quench Protection Unit damages coils.
- reactor.tritiumContamination: whether tritium releases contaminate their surroundings.
- reactor.neutronEffectsOnMobs: whether neutrons dose mobs (players always).
- reactor.huPerMegawatt: the heat each MW gives (the reactor's FE output).
- reactor.dhe3Boost: how easily D-He3 burns.
- tritium.halfLifeDays and tritium.leakPerMinute; cryogenics.boilOffPerMinute.
